open_questions: Cursor field semantics (window.time/last_time/index/last_index and slot +0x02 cached index) are named from observed use; the original may use different roles. Offsets are exact.
Ghidra returned float types for fn_080c34fe and fn_080c38e6 whose x87 returns may be long double; treated as float here. Confirm return widths in their own chunk.

The clip head word at +0x00 is used as a 16-bit count in XAnim_EvalNodeParts and as a pointer (fn_0807943c path) in XAnim_BuildPartMap; both reads are translated literally and should be reconciled with the owner chunk.
XAnim_InsertPendingEntry (FUN_080be4ae) has no capacity check; the capacity of g_085e4920 is unknown.
Callback parameters use function-pointer types (void *(*)(int) and void (*)(void *, int)); merge lane may map them to a shared allocator typedef.

Key loops in FUN_080be554 are stepped by one 8-byte key (asm add 0x8) although Ghidra printed a 16-byte step; verified in disassembly, but the iteration bound should be confirmed by a differential test.
Float expressions follow decompiler operand order; x87 extended-precision intermediates the original may keep in registers are not reproduced bit-for-bit.
